'''Bhixen''' was a senior [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Togorian/Legends|Togorian]] [[Padawan/Legends|Jedi apprentice]] in [[Jedi training/Legends|training]] in the [[Jedi Academy (Shedu Maad)|Jedi Academy]] on [[Shedu Maad]] soon after the [[Lost Tribe of Sith emergence]].

In [[45 ABY]], he passed the Trials under the supervision of the [[Jedi High Council (New Jedi Order)|Jedi Council]] in order to become the apprentice of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Jaina Solo Fel]]. Unfortunately, the young [[Togorian/Legends|Togorian]], although promising, showed too much pride and aggressiveness, so instead of being paired with Solo, Bhixen was retrograded, with his consent, to the rank of Novice in order to learn humility.
